project.name: Inspecto — backup / restore maintenance tasks (Standard edition, optional)
project.description:
OPTIONAL Standard-edition maintenance tasks (EDITIONS.md OPS-06, "Backup / restore"): the `backup`, `backup_verify` and `restore` tasks of the `maintenance` Job Type, contributed through the core's com.gamma.job.MaintenanceTaskProvider ServiceLoader seam.
WHY THIS MODULE EXISTS (EDG-01 cell 2, 2026-09-07). OPS-06 was decided "not for Personal" on 2026-09-02, and BackupTask nonetheless shipped in every bundle because it lived in inspecto-engine, an unconditional dependency of the app. The matrix cell was a product decision the build did not apply. Dropping THIS jar on the classpath is what makes the three tasks exist; on a Personal bundle they are unknown maintenance tasks, refused loudly, never silently skipped.
THIN, like inspecto-policy: it needs nothing beyond what the core already supplies (Jackson, slf4j, Checksums, PathJail, ComponentStore), so there is no shade and no sidecar classifier.
Built only under the "edition-standard"/"edition-enterprise" profiles (see the parent pom's profile-scoped <modules>), so a routine "mvn -o clean test" (= Personal, the DEFAULT build -- there is no -Pedition-personal) never compiles or tests it.
